title: Analytic stacks and their six-functor formalisms
summary: Abstract three- and six-functor formalisms (correspondences, Liu–Zheng gluing, the construction and extension theorems, the kernel bicategory, suave/prim/étale/proper calculus, !-equivalence topoi); quasi-coherent formalism of algebraic stacks in the !-topology; light analytic animated rings, smashing localizations, solid structures and solid Huber rings; analytic stacks AnStk(C₀) with their quasi-coherent formalism and the realization of algebraic stacks; Betti and classifying stacks, nuclear modules and Fredholm rings; the cotangent complex of analytic rings; solid smoothness and Serre duality f^!1 ≅ det(L)[n]; Cartier duality in Künneth formalisms and its instances.
